description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.

summary.one_liner: A Claude Code-based job application framework that evaluates postings, tailors LaTeX CVs and cover letters, and preps interview packs, run locally from your own fork.
summary.what_it_does: The repository is a set of Claude Code commands and skills that run a job search from a forked copy on the user's machine. /setup builds a profile from a documents folder, a pasted CV, or an interview. /scrape searches job portals through CLI skills, and /rank batch-scores results into a shortlist. /apply evaluates fit, drafts a CV and cover letter in LaTeX, has a second agent review them, compiles the PDFs, and checks the CV text layer for ATS parseability. /interview builds stage-specific prep packs and mock interviews, while /outcome, /gmail-sync, /notion-sync and /html-report track results. The shipped portal skills target Danish job boards, and two country-agnostic ones are included: linkedin-search and freehire-search.
use_cases: Tailoring a CV and cover letter to a specific job posting
Scoring many scraped job postings for fit and ranking them
Preparing for a scheduled job interview with a mock interview
Tracking application outcomes and drafting follow-up emails
Searching job boards from the command line
Mapping skill gaps against target job postings
notable: Drafter-reviewer workflow: a second Claude agent with fresh context critiques the drafts before revision
Compile-and-inspect loop renders the PDFs and iterates on LaTeX until page layout is clean
Deterministic integrity gate strips hidden text and flags injection-shaped lines in job postings before evaluation
Portal skills are auto-discovered folders with a common CLI contract, so new job boards can be added or borrowed
Honesty rule: the system does not invent skills or experience and lists keyword gaps instead of stuffing them
caveats: Claude Code requires a paid Claude subscription or API credits; there is no free tier
A fork is public by default, and the README advises a private repo for personal data
Built-in portal skills are for the Danish market; other markets need /add-portal or a borrowed skill, and LinkedIn use is against its ToS
Requires a LaTeX distribution with lualatex and xelatex installed
